status: materialized before the freeze; X0003 binds the hash of this file
question: If we train on the exact same chess positions, can 2k labels replace 8k labels without materially hurting the student?
why: S8 removed the student-compute confound and showed that cheaper labels are not worse; S9 removes breadth as a variable entirely, so the only thing that changes is how hard the teacher thought when producing each target.

positions.record_ids: frozen from the S8 state (arm 8k), verified against its dataset split
positions.why_zero_new_compute: the 2k stream already contains the 8k prefix, so both targets exist for these positions: no new teacher labeling is required

datasets.SAME-9495-8K: the 9,495 positions with their 8k targets (reused from S8 if it reproduces exactly: same ids, same order, same spec)
datasets.SAME-9495-2K: the SAME 9,495 ids in the SAME order, with their 2k targets

training.regime: fixed updates (the S8 control): MAX_UPDATES 760, BATCH 256 = 194,560 sample presentations for every arm

identical.data_order_rng: the same training seed drives the sampler in both arms

training.seed_note: twenty seeds because this is an equivalence / non-inferiority question where narrow intervals matter

primary_analysis.quantity: d = test_loss(2k) - test_loss(8k), paired by seed, per width

margin.why: the 16k-to-8k improvements we treated as meaningful were 0.003-0.007, so a degradation below 0.001 is economically negligible relative to effects already taken seriously

decision.2K_NONINFERIOR: upper bound < +0.001 at all four widths
decision.FLOOR_CROSSED: lower bound > +0.001 at every width (2k has crossed the useful-label floor)
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: any width's upper bound exceeds +0.001 (or the decisive conditions are otherwise unmet)

primary_analysis.secondary_equivalence: does the entire two-sided 95% CI (t = 2.093, df=19) lie inside [-0.001, +0.001]? That separates 'not materially worse' from 'practically indistinguishable'

economics.statement_source: realized node totals over the same 9,495 positions, not nominal depth x rows
economics.expected_ratio: 8k is roughly 4x the 2k cost on the same positions
economics.note: the labels already exist, so this measures the counterfactual economics from frozen observations rather than spending the compute again

secondary_disagreement_analysis.purpose: record how much the 2k and 8k teachers actually disagree on these positions; analysis only, never a selection mechanism
measures: absolute cp difference (mean, median, p90, p99)
move disagreement if both values carry moves
secondary_disagreement_analysis.hypothesis_to_look_for: if the teachers disagree substantially per position while students trained on them perform essentially identically, the network may only need the teacher to place a position in roughly the right part of evaluation space
secondary_disagreement_analysis.bucket_error_caveat: the trainer records aggregate losses only, so per-bucket student error is computed as IN-SAMPLE fit on the training positions and is labelled as such

firewall.no_outcome_inspection: the complete 160-cell matrix and its X0003 must be frozen before any training outcome is inspected

stop_conditions: the 9,495 ids do not reproduce from the S8 evidence
the two datasets do not contain exactly the same ids in the same order
either TargetSpec cannot provide strict one-observation cardinality
X0003 cannot truthfully seal the intended 160-cell design
